provenance: Sanitized values transcribed from closed E1-E4 reports; no checkpoints, trajectories, or private paths included.

e1_representation.interpretation: Limited linear accessibility, not physical understanding or improved control.

e2_prediction.metric: prior continuation probability at actual-fall endpoints
e2_prediction.interpretation: Optimistic terminal continuation near actual falls; posterior reconstruction is not genuine future prediction.

e3_action_feedback.metric: negative ankle correction minus zero correction restricted one-second return
e3_action_feedback.interpretation: Positive finite-window effect; all conditions survived one second, so durable rescue was not demonstrated.

e4_explicit_control.metric: BLF commissioning duration before numerical admission stop
e4_explicit_control.stop_reason: passive-neck residual exceeded the numerical guard
e4_explicit_control.interpretation: Guard-censored commissioning result, not a physical fall or successful WBC comparison.
